app.title: YouTube Ad Punisher – Auto-reloads YouTube pages when an ad plays
app.description: A browser extension that auto‑reloads YouTube pages when an ad is detected, improving viewing experience for users.
proposed_tests: Install the extension in Chrome and verify it is active on youtube.com
Simulate an ad appearance and ensure the page reloads automatically
Measure the reload latency and compare to manual reload time
Disable the extension and confirm no reload occurs
